name: slider
title: Slider
description: A native range input: a thin well with a pearl thumb.
use: A value from a range where the position matters more than the exact number: volume, opacity, zoom. The browser keeps the keys, the form value and touch dragging.

instead.when: Two values on one scale, such as a lowest and a highest price
The exact number matters and the reader steps it
The exact number matters and the reader types it

keyboard.action: Move the value by one step, as the native range input does
Move to the lowest or the highest value

platform.fallback: Firefox fills the track natively through ::-moz-range-progress; elsewhere the track stays an empty well and the thumb still shows the value

classes.name: slider
classes.description: A range input: a thin well with a pearl thumb, filled with ink before the thumb
